name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY / Beti Bachao Beti Padhao)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts, Government of India
description: Sukanya Samriddhi Account is a government-backed small savings scheme designed specifically for the financial security and higher education of the girl child, offering high sovereign interest rates and EEE tax exemption.
benefits: Minimum annual deposit is only Rs. 250 (up to Rs. 1,50,000 per financial year)
Deposits can be made for 15 years from account opening date
Triple tax benefits (EEE: exempt deposit, exempt interest, exempt maturity under Section 80C)
Partial withdrawal up to 50% allowed for girl child's higher education after she attains 18 years
eligibility: Account can be opened by the natural or legal guardian in the name of a girl child
Girl child must be an Indian citizen from birth up to 10 years of age
Maximum of 2 accounts per family (one per girl child; 3 allowed in case of twin/triplet girls born in first or second order of birth)
documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child issued by municipal authority or registrar
Identity proof of guardian (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Passport, or Driving License)
Address proof of guardian (Aadhaar Card, utility bill, or ration card)
PAN Card or Form 60 of the guardian
Passport-size photographs of the girl child and guardian
steps: Visit your nearest Post Office branch or authorized commercial bank (SBI, PNB, BoB, etc.)
Collect and fill the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Opening Form (Form-1)
Attach photocopies of the girl child's birth certificate and guardian's KYC documents
Deposit the opening amount (minimum Rs. 250 in cash, cheque, or demand draft)
Collect your official SSY Passbook with account number, guardian name, and child details
human_helpers: Postmaster or Postal Assistant at your local Post Office
Customer service desk at any authorized public/private commercial bank branch
Gram Dak Sevak (GDS) in rural areas
